newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher on spillover.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher on spillover.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled higher in thin dealings on a mixture of spillover strength from outside markets and on a lack of selling, traders said.

"Basically we followed Chicago higher on a lack of selling," an MGE floor source said. "I think the key, though, was that volume was really light -- after you subtract our cash trade today's volume comes to about 16 million bushels."
CBOT and KCBT wheat futures gained on a mix of fund-buying and on speculative buying tied to rumors that Egypt may tender for 750,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
Traders said they had seen some short covering ahead of Friday's USDA crop report. Light mill buying also helped support MGE spring wheat, traders said.
Cargill, a featured seller over the past week, sold 1.2 million Sept on the day. Prudential Securities sold one million Sept.
MGE spring wheat settled two to 10-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with new crop September up 8-1/4 cents at $3.59-1/4.
